segments.an5.138:1.1: “Pañcahi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo bhattādako ca hoti okāsapharaṇo ca laṇḍasāraṇo ca salākaggāhī ca rañño nāgotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
segments.an5.138:1.3: Idha, bhikkhave, rañño nāgo akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ, akkhamo saddānaṃ, akkhamo gandhānaṃ, akkhamo rasānaṃ, akkhamo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ.
segments.an5.138:1.4: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi aṅgehi samannāgato rañño nāgo bhattādako ca okāsapharaṇo ca laṇḍasāraṇo ca salākaggāhī ca, rañño nāgotveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
segments.an5.138:2.1: “Evamevaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhattādako ca hoti, okāsapharaṇo ca mañcapīṭhamaddano [pīṭhamaddano (sī. syā. kaṃ. pī.)] ca salākaggāhī ca, bhikkhutveva saṅkhaṃ gacchati.
segments.an5.138:2.3: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu akkhamo hoti rūpānaṃ, akkhamo saddānaṃ, akkhamo gandhānaṃ, akkhamo rasānaṃ, akkhamo phoṭṭhabbānaṃ.
segments.an5.138:2.4: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu bhattādako ca hoti okāsapharaṇo ca mañcapīṭhamaddano ca salākaggāhī ca, bhikkhutveva saṅkhaṃ gacchatī”ti.

lines: Okāsapharaṇoti okāsaṃ pharitvā aññesaṃ sambādhaṃ katvā ṭhānena okāsapharaṇo.
Hatthīti hi hatthivisayattā hatthisannissitattā ca hatthisippaṃ gahitaṃ.
Vayatīti vayo, sobhanesu katthaci apakkhalanto avitthāyanto tāni sandhāretuṃ sakkotīti attho.
Na vayo avayo, tāni atthato saddato ca sandhāretuṃ na sakkoti.
Dve paṭisedhā pakatiṃ gamentīti āha “anavayoti samattho”ti.
